title: Pure Bounzer
summary: Nistro's Bounzer archetype paired with Level 6 Warrior extenders, The Monarchs Stormforth, and Rank 6 Xyz bosses. The deck cheats Level 6 Warriors onto the field without standard Tributes and overlays them into Photon Strike Bounzer and Evolzar Lars.

summary.title: Starters & Tribute Enablers
points: Hammer Bounzer (Level 6, 2300 ATK) Normal Summons itself without Tributing when the opponent controls a card and you control no cards.
Spell Striker banishes a Spell from the GY to Special Summon itself from the hand, providing free Tribute fodder for Phantom Bounzer or Hammer Bounzer while keeping your Spell & Trap Zone empty.
The Monarchs Stormforth lets you Tribute an opponent's monster to Tribute Summon Phantom Bounzer or Hammer Bounzer, clearing an opposing threat past destruction protection.
Reinforcement of the Army searches Blade Bounzer or Spell Striker from the Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Phantom Bounzer + Cyber Tutubon or Rank 6 Extender
steps: Special Summon Spell Striker (or activate The Monarchs Stormforth going second) and Tribute Summon Phantom Bounzer.

Equip Phantom Bounzer with Bound Wand or Tribute it from the field to Special Summon Cyber Tutubon; when Phantom Bounzer is sent from the field to the GY, it searches any 2 Bounzer cards (Hammer Bounzer and Bounzer Guard).
Pair two Level 6 monsters (Hammer Bounzer, Phantom Bounzer revived by Bound Wand, Performapal Handsamuraiger, or Parry Knights) to Xyz Summon Photon Strike Bounzer or Evolzar Lars.

summary.title: Phantom Bounzer & Spell-Free Synergy
summary.text: Phantom Bounzer searches any 2 Bounzer cards from the Deck whenever it is sent from anywhere on the field to the GY (whether destroyed, Tributed, or linked off, though not when detached as Xyz Material). Hammer Bounzer requires you to control no Spells or Traps when it declares an attack to prevent the opponent from activating Spell/Trap Cards until the end of the Damage Step, which is why Spell Striker and handtraps are favored over permanent backrow.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Photon Strike Bounzer detaches 1 Xyz Material as a Quick Effect on the opponent's turn to negate any monster effect activated on their field and inflict 1000 burn damage.
Evolzar Lars detaches 1 material to negate the effects of any face-up card the opponent controls until the end of the turn.
Number 24: Dragulas the Vampiric Dragon flips a Special Summoned monster face-down as a Quick Effect and sends a card on the field to the GY when flipped face-up.
Gauntlet Launcher detaches materials to destroy up to 2 monsters the opponent controls, while Bounzer Guard protects a Bounzer from battle or card destruction and draws attacks onto it.

summary.title: Spells & Extenders
points: Bound Wand boosts a Warrior's ATK by 100 times its Level (giving Phantom Bounzer and Hammer Bounzer 600 ATK) and revives the equipped monster from the GY when destroyed by the opponent.
Parry Knights Special Summons itself from the hand when you take battle damage and summons another monster with ATK less than or equal to that damage, setting up a Rank 6 on the crackback.
Blade Bounzer discards a card after attacking an opponent's monster to make a second attack against a monster in the same Battle Phase.

allow.Spell Striker: Special Summons itself by banishing a Spell from the GY without leaving a Spell/Trap on the field, providing Tribute fodder for Bounzers.
allow.Cyber Tutubon: Level 5 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons itself from the hand by Tributing a Warrior or Fairy.
allow.Performapal Handsamuraiger: Level 6 Warrior that protects Bounzer monsters or acts as Level 6 Rank 6 material.
allow.The Monarchs Stormforth: Tributes an opponent's monster to Normal Summon Hammer Bounzer, Phantom Bounzer, or Blade Bounzer.
allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches Blade Bounzer or Spell Striker.
allow.Parry Knights: Level 6 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons itself when you take battle damage to facilitate Rank 6 plays.
allow.Bound Wand: Equips to a Spellcaster or Warrior to revive it when destroyed by an opponent's card.
allow.Number 24: Dragulas the Vampiric Dragon: Rank 6 Xyz made with two Level 6 Bounzers that flips opposing monsters face-down and sends cards to the GY.
allow.Gauntlet Launcher: Rank 6 Warrior Xyz made with two Level 6 Bounzers that detaches materials to destroy opposing monsters.
allow.Evolzar Lars: Rank 6 Xyz made with two Level 6 Bounzers that provides omni-negation.

main: Hammer Bounzer
Level 6 Warrior with 2300 ATK that can be Normal Summoned without Tributing if the opponent controls a card and you control no cards.
Phantom Bounzer
Level 6 Warrior with 2400 ATK that searches any 2 'Bounzer' cards from the Deck when sent from the field to the GY.
Blade Bounzer
Level 4 Warrior that discards a card after attacking an opponent's monster to make a second attack on a monster.
Bounzer Guard
Normal Trap that protects a Bounzer from battle and card targeting, forcing opponent attacks onto it.
Spell Striker
Banishes a Spell from the GY to Special Summon itself, leaving your field clear of Spells/Traps for Hammer Bounzer's attack effect.
Cyber Tutubon
Tributes Phantom Bounzer from hand or field to Special Summon itself and trigger Phantom Bounzer's double search.
Performapal Handsamuraiger
Level 6 Warrior that tributes a monster to gain ATK and pairs with Hammer/Phantom Bounzer for Rank 6 plays.
The Monarchs Stormforth
Lets you Tribute an opponent's monster to Tribute Summon Phantom Bounzer or Hammer Bounzer.
Reinforcement of the Army
Searches Blade Bounzer or Spell Striker.
Bound Wand
Equips to a monster and revives it when destroyed.
Parry Knights
Level 6 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons itself when you take battle damage to enable instant Rank 6 plays.
extra: Signature Rank 6 Xyz boss that detaches 1 material to negate any monster effect on the opponent's field and inflict 1000 burn damage.
Rank 6 Warrior Xyz that detaches 1 material up to twice per turn to destroy an opponent's monster.
Rank 6 Xyz that flips Special Summoned monsters face-down as a Quick Effect.
Rank 6 Xyz that detaches 1 material to negate the effects of any face-up card the opponent controls.
